title: webhooks.encode
description: Exact bytes of a webhook POST body for a payload (BE-WH-12, BE-WH-13). The payload is the JSON value stored at emission; the body is its compact JSON re-encoding: keys in stored order, no whitespace, strings escaped with \" \\ \b \f \n \r \t, other characters below U+0020 as \u00XX (lowercase hex), '<' '>' '&' as \u003c \u003e \u0026, U+2028/U+2029 as \u2028/\u2029, every other character (incl. U+007F and non-ASCII) raw UTF-8, '/' unescaped; integers exact; binary64 floats per the float rule of BE-WH-12. Content-Type is application/json.

payload_json.description: JSON text of the payload object (number spelling is irrelevant: numbers are read as binary64 floats when they have a fraction or exponent, as integers otherwise).
